goal: Establish a coherent premium design system and Vietnamese typography foundation
context: Foundation for the approved AI Inbox Pro redesign. Inspect and preserve current uncommitted changes. Use the audit at research/reports/20261020-ai-inbox-ux-reference-audit.md; do not copy competitor branding.
requirements: Inventory current shared styles, route-specific CSS, fonts, icon approach, and responsive breakpoints before changing tokens
Define semantic color, typography, spacing/grid, radii, border, shadow, focus, motion, and z-index tokens appropriate to B2B SaaS
Select a sharp Vietnamese-capable type system with clear display/body/UI roles and robust fallback; verify diacritics, line breaks, numeric readability, and weights
Standardize shared navigation, buttons, links, badges/status, form controls, content widths, and focus-visible behavior without flattening distinct page identities
Remove generic gradient/glow effects, gratuitous emoji, unsemantic card borders, conflicting overrides, and overlapping floating layers where present
acceptance_criteria: Typography and Vietnamese diacritics are visually checked at desktop and mobile sizes with no clipping or awkward wrapping
Shared tokens are the source of truth and route-specific styles consume them rather than duplicating contradictory values
Focus, contrast, reduced-motion, semantic hierarchy, and overlay z-index are verified
Document the token choices and representative components; do not proceed to Landing until foundation review passes
